title: Technology Knowledge Optimization in Type 1 Diabetes (TeKnO T1D): Parents
eligibility_text:
Inclusion Criteria:

1. child 8-12 years of age with a diagnosis of T1D >= 6 months
2. currently using insulin pump( IP) and CGM >= 1 month [including Hybrid Closed Loop (HCL) systems]
3. participation of primary diabetes caregiver
4. English fluency
5. mean A1c >7.5% over the past 6 months (Aim 3 only)

Exclusion Criteria:

1. major illnesses other than T1D in the child
2. significant cognitive limitations or major psychiatric disorders in the child or parent
3. the use of medications other than insulin to control blood glucose levels.

title: Individualized Lifestyle Intervention in Subjects With Prediabetes
eligibility_text:
Inclusion Criteria:

* impaired fasting glucose (IFG)

 * fasting blood glucose 99-126 mg/dl

and/or

* impaired glucose tolerance (IGT)

 * 75 g OGTT 120 minutes: 139-200 mg/dl

Exclusion Criteria:

* current pregnancy or breastfeeding
* BMI > 45 kg/m2
* Diabetes mellitus Typ 1 or 2
* serious disease e.g symptomatic coronary heart disease
* severe mental illness
* drug abuse
* treatment with steroids
* potentially incompliant subjects

title: Metabolic Responses of Dapagliflozin vs Sitagliptin in T2DM Patients Inadequately Controlled With Insulin Therapy
eligibility_text:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Chinese
* Aged 21 to 75 both inclusive
* Type 2 diabetes on single or two doses of insulin therapy with or without metformin
* Suboptimal glycaemic control with baseline HbA1c >=8.0% and <=10.5%, taken within 2 months prior to randomization
* Body mass index between 21 and 40 kg/m2

Exclusion Criteria:

* Type 1 diabetes mellitus
* History of ketoacidosis
* Pregnant or nursing women
* Severe mental disorder
* Unable to understand written patient information and to give informed consent

title: Efficacy and Safety of Lobaplatin and Carboplatin as Neoadjuvant Therapy in HER-2 Positive Breast Cancer
eligibility_text:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Newly diagnosed breast cancer
* 18-70 Years, female;
* life expectancy is not less than 3 months
* Histologically confirmed HER2 positive
* at least one measurable lesion according to RECIST 1.1
* Neutrophils >= 1.5x10^9/L
* Platelets >= 100x10^9/L
* Left ventricular ejection fraction (LVEF) >= 50%

Exclusion Criteria:

* Stage IV (metastatic) breast cancer or bilateral breast cancer
* Inflammatory breast cancer
* patients who received chemotherapy, endocrine therapy, immunotherapy, biotherapy or TACE within 4 weeks before admission
* Has a known history of Human Immunodeficiency Virus (HIV)
* Female patients during pregnancy and lactation
* History of neurological or psychiatric disorders, including epilepsy or dementia

title: Radiation Therapy in Treating Post-Menopausal Women With Early Stage Breast Cancer Undergoing Surgery
eligibility_text:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Core needle biopsy showing invasive mammary cancer or ductal carcinoma in situ
* Age >= 50 years and postmenopausal with no menses for at least one year prior to study enrollment
* Human epidermal growth factor receptor 2 (HER2)/neu negative on the core biopsy analysis
* Unicentric tumor
* Axillary lymph nodes negative by pre-operative physical examination
* Negative surgical margins

Exclusion Criteria:

* Initial core biopsy showing invasive lobular cancer
* Any Her 2+ breast cancer
* Cancer in a patient with a known inherited susceptibility mutation in breast cancer (BRCA)1 or BRCA2
* Any prior breast cancer
* Prior breast radiation therapy

title: Hormone Therapy in Treating Women With Breast Cancer
eligibility_text:
DISEASE CHARACTERISTICS: Histologically proven locally advanced or metastatic breast cancer. Evaluable or bidimensionally measurable disease. No rapid disease progression requiring chemotherapy. Hormone receptor status: Estrogen receptor positive AND/OR Progesterone receptor positive.

PATIENT CHARACTERISTICS: Age: 18 and over Sex: Female Performance status: ECOG 0-1 Life expectancy: At least 24 weeks Hematopoietic: Granulocyte count at least 1500/mm3 Platelet count at least 100,000/mm3 Other: Not pregnant or nursing

PRIOR CONCURRENT THERAPY: No prior chemotherapy for metastatic breast cancer. No concurrent chemotherapy. No prior hormonal therapy for metastatic breast cancer (except tamoxifen).

title: Health cAre woRkers exposeD to COVID-19
eligibility_text:
Inclusion Criteria in the cohort:

* >= 18 years of age.
* French speaking.
* Health care workers: physicians, residents in medicine or pharmacy, nurses, auxiliary nurses.
* Working in metropolitan French public or private hospitals.
* Have taken care of patients with COVID-19.
* Written informed consent obtained from the participant.

Exclusion Criteria in the cohort:

* none

title: Kintsugi Voice Device Pivotal Study
eligibility_text:
Inclusion Criteria:

Age >22 at the time of informed consent. Self-reported disruption to activities of daily living. Access to a laptop, smartphone, tablet, or other device with a functioning microphone and access to the Internet. Stated willingness to be video and audio recorded as part of the study. Resides in the United States at the time of consent and during completion of study.

-

Exclusion Criteria:

* Participants with at least one of the following conditions will be excluded:

Any impairment that impacts their ability to speak and/or use a computer. Any lifetime history of neurological disease. Any lifetime history of Stroke, cognitive defect, and/or Traumatic Brain Injury. Past or active heavy smokers (an average of >20 cigarettes per day).

title: Increased Lung Volume as Controller Therapy for Asthma
eligibility_text:
Inclusion Criteria for people with asthma:

1. Physician diagnosis of asthma
2. PC20 to methacholine < 16 mg/ml
3. IgE < 100 IU/ml
4. Ages 18-65 years
5. BMI >=30 kg/m2

Exclusion Criteria:

1. FEV1 < 60 % predicted
2. Other significant disease that in the opinion of the investigator would interfere with study.
3. Inability to perform required testing.
4. Smoking within last 6 months.
5. >= 20 pack year smoking history
6. Pregnancy

title: BI 443651 Methacholine Challenge
eligibility_text:
Inclusion criteria:

* Male or female subjects must have a diagnosis of asthma by a physician at least 3 months prior to screening.
* Age >= 18 <= 60 years. Subjects must be within the eligible age range on the day of signing informed consent.
* Diagnosis of asthma must have been made before the subject's age of 40.
* ACQ value < 1.5 at the screening visit.
* Body mass index (BMI) >= 18.5 and <= 32.0 kg/m2 at the screening visit

Exclusion criteria:

* Significant pulmonary diseases other than asthma
* Respiratory tract infection or asthma exacerbation in the 4 weeks prior to the screening visit.
* Hospitalisation for asthma exacerbation within 3 months or intubation for asthma within 3 years of the screening visit.
* Current smokers or ex-smokers who have given up smoking for < 12 months

title: Goal Setting and Mobile-based Self-management Tool to Improve Diet Quality of People With High Blood Pressure
Safety and Efficacy of Aliskiren in Pediatric Hypertensive Patients 6-17 Years of Age
eligibility_text:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Documented diagnosis of hypertension as defined in the NHLBI 4th Report, 2004
* msSBP (mean of 3 measurements) must be >= 95th percentile for age, gender and height, at Visit 2 (randomization) measurement

Exclusion Criteria:

* Patient receiving immunosuppressant medication other than oral/topical steroids, for any medical condition
* Current diagnosis of heart failure (NYHA Class II-IV) or history of cardiomyopathy or obstructive valvular disease
* Second or third degree heart block without a pacemaker
* Creatinine clearance < 30 mL/min/1.73m2

title: A Multi-center RWS of Perampanel as an add-on Treatment for Epileptic Seizures in Chinese Children
Cannabis Extract in Refractory Epilepsy Study
eligibility_text:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Diagnosis of epilepsy according to the ILAE classification.
* At least 4 motor seizures per month at the start of the study, despite treatment with at least two different anti-epileptic drugs for at least one year.
* Stable dose(s) of the same AED(s) for one month prior to screening.
* Is planning to stay in Canada for the duration of the trial.

Exclusion Criteria:

* Participation in a study involving administration of an investigational compound within one month of Visit 1.
* Progressive central nervous system (CNS) disease, including degenerative CNS diseases and progressive tumors.
* Occurrence of psychogenic seizures in the previous year.
* Pregnancy, breastfeeding.
* Patients with a history of major depression, suicidal ideation or attempted suicide, schizophrenia or any other psychotic disorder
